description: This file is a C header file defining functions and macros related to Internationalized Domain Name (IDN) handling for cURL, including declarations for hostname conversion, encoding, decoding, and memory management functions.
external_files: copying information from the license header; actual external file references are managed within implementation files

methods.name: Curl_is_ASCII_name
methods.description: Checks if the provided hostname consists only of ASCII characters.

methods.name: Curl_idnconvert_hostname
methods.description: Converts a hostname to its IDN (Internationalized Domain Name) form.

methods.name: Curl_free_idnconverted_hostname
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a converted hostname.

methods.name: Curl_idn_decode
methods.description: Decodes an IDN-encoded string back to its Unicode form.

methods.name: Curl_idn_encode
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode hostname into IDN format.
